correctness.rationale: Read pinned RESULT.md, verifier, Pendyala source formula and full source tree. For egg |z|²+|w|^4<1, scalar X=w conj(eta)/(1−<z,zeta>)^(1/2) obeys |X|<1 by ball Cauchy–Schwarz and axial points z=zeta=0 realize any X with |X|<1. Pendyala Thm 4.2 gives nonvanishing outer factor times polynomial numerator (1−X)^n Σ_{j>=0}(mu+j/2)_{n−1} X^j, mu=(n+2)/(2(n+1)). Since rising factorial is degree n−1 in j, finite differences exactly reconstruct degree n−1 numerator from first n terms. For n=2..11 independently computed ALL exact rational numerator polynomials and Cayley H_n(u)=(1+u)^(n−1)P_n((1−u)/(1+u)); exact Routh first-column signs all plus for n2..10 and ++++++-++++ for n11 (two changes), no imaginary-axis roots (real/imag polynomial gcd1) or zero pivots, so disk root counts 0 and 2. n11 alternating coefficients exclude real roots on negative real axis and positive generating series excludes positive (0,1); exact gcd(P,Pprime)=1 makes two complex conjugates simple. Finite range n<=11 fully exhaustive exact certificate; no claim about >=12. Routh theorem and analytic kernel derivation, not approximate roots, establish all quantifiers.
